description: This file defines the SerializationConstructorFactory class, which creates delegates for calling ISerializable-conformant constructors within the Orleans.Serialization namespace. It manages the creation and caching of constructor invokers for types that implement ISerializable, including methods to identify the presence of serialization constructors and generate dynamic methods for constructor invocation.

classes.name: SerializationConstructorFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating delegates that invoke ISerializable-conformant constructors, and managing their caching for types within the Orleans.Serialization namespace.

methods.name: HasSerializationConstructor
methods.description: Checks whether a given type has a serialization constructor.

methods.name: GetSerializationConstructorDelegate
methods.description: Returns a delegate that can invoke the serialization constructor for a given type.

methods.name: GetSerializationConstructorDelegate<TOwner, TConstructor>
methods.description: Generic method to get a serialization constructor delegate with specified owner and delegate types.
